final_draft.answer: Two. Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: The approved answer (valid until 2027-11-16) matches a live check of harborlight/app run at 2026-11-16T17:08:56Z. That check showed main is protected, needs 2 approving reviews and applies the rule to administrators. Both sources cover only the harborlight/app repository, so if the customer means all repositories, this answer doesn't cover that.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:b7ffcf96-fb3a-4033-8112-256e160ba: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:29fbf8ff-0b70-47d2-b7fc-beca9c5c9: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:d0045c43-4776-4b0c-95f5-be1130ba6: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:6ae90aa9-4e21-442c-ac6a-4a198245c: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:31129a84-06bb-442e-916e-84f4d5896: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
evidence:08d93f76-1a10-4a65-b5d1-31f9361: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 2 approving reviews before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-16 17:08 UTC.
